gear-weapon#0135._raw: Found at the site of the Caritat Mansion, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.

gear-weapon#0136.src: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.
gear-weapon#0136.dst: Un serment de protection plane sur cette lance, désormais habitée par l'esprit d'une héroïne légendaire. Un simple regard sur sa lame ardente suffit à inspirer un sentiment de protection et de sécurité, et ce sentiment se révélera fondé pour qui aura le courage de la manier.
gear-weapon#0136.flat: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.

gear-weapon#0137.src: Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.
gear-weapon#0137.dst: Taillées dans des parties inconnues d'une créature marine jamais vue, les écailles colossales de cette effigie des profondeurs exercent... une attraction. Un poids, une pression. Une profondeur terrible et écrasante s'abat sur celui qui la tient, l'enveloppant comme la nostalgie. Son propriétaire observe, une part de lui-même vivement consciente des morceaux qui lui manquent.
gear-weapon#0137.flat: Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.

gear-weapon#0138.src: As a flashing star shot through the night sky, a sole observer witnessed its brilliance. It was then, wreathed in prismatic light, he decided. Someday, he would shine as bright as that star, and overtake those beneath him. No matter the cost.
gear-weapon#0138.dst: Lorsqu'une étoile filante traversa le ciel nocturne, un unique observateur fut témoin de son éclat. C'est alors, auréolé d'une lumière prismatique, qu'il prit sa décision. Un jour, il brillerait autant que cette étoile et surpasserait ceux qui étaient en dessous de lui. Quel qu'en soit le prix.
gear-weapon#0138.flat: As a flashing star shot through the night sky, a sole observer witnessed its brilliance. It was then, wreathed in prismatic light, he decided. Someday, he would shine as bright as that star, and overtake those beneath him. No matter the cost.

gear-weapon#0139.src: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.
gear-weapon#0139.dst: L'ennemi le plus dangereux est celui que vous ne voyez pas. Cachée dans un tourbillon de pétales survient une avalanche de coups qui, en un instant, dissout montagnes et forêts en un amalgame grandissant, et l'instant d'après laisse un sillage de fleurs éclatantes.
gear-weapon#0139.flat: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.

gear-weapon#0140.src: The weathered oar of Haros, the outcast ferryman of Charon's Forsaken Legion. Magical implements have been jury-rigged onto the silver pole, glowing dull out of his bony grasp.
gear-weapon#0140.dst: La rame usée de Haros, le passeur banni de la Légion abandonnée de Charon. Des instruments magiques ont été bricolés sur la perche d'argent, et luisent faiblement hors de sa main osseuse.
gear-weapon#0140.flat: The weathered oar of Haros, the outcast ferryman of Charon's Forsaken Legion. Magical implements have been jury-rigged onto the silver pole, glowing dull out of his bony grasp.

gear-weapon#0141.src: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from {p} were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.
gear-weapon#0141.dst: La technologie corkian ne fut pas la première à créer un objet capable d'enregistrer des sons. On découvrit que des artefacts de {p} enregistraient les sons ambiants et les déformaient en salves sonores assourdissantes.
gear-weapon#0141.flat: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from {p} were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.
gear-weapon#0141._raw: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from Time Valley were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.

gear-weapon#0142.src: The runes carved onto the spear shift appearance so quickly as to be illegible, but those who wield it supposedly will learn their meaning.
gear-weapon#0142.dst: Les runes gravées sur la lance changent d'apparence si vite qu'elles en sont illisibles, mais ceux qui la manient finiraient par en apprendre le sens.
gear-weapon#0142.flat: The runes carved onto the spear shift appearance so quickly as to be illegible, but those who wield it supposedly will learn their meaning.

gear-weapon#0143.src: "Betrayal stings sharper than a scorpion's tail, and festers worse than the poison inside."   -Attributed to Hashr
gear-weapon#0143.dst: "La trahison pique plus fort que la queue d'un scorpion, et s'envenime plus que le poison qu'elle contient."   -Attribué à Hashr
gear-weapon#0143.flat: "Betrayal stings sharper than a scorpion's tail, and festers worse than the poison inside."   -Attributed to Hashr

gear-weapon#0144.src: Everything slowly loses heat, and will eventually stop moving. Are you prepared?
gear-weapon#0144.dst: Tout perd lentement sa chaleur et finira par cesser de bouger. Êtes-vous prêt?
gear-weapon#0144.flat: Everything slowly loses heat, and will eventually stop moving. Are you prepared?

gear-weapon#0145.src: Among the outcasts of {p}, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.
gear-weapon#0145.dst: Parmi les parias de {p}, certains prêchent qu'il ne faut pas craindre la mort. Ils disent que si le chemin jusqu'à sa porte est infernal, et son messager des plus cruels, l'au-delà pardonne. Dans cette lance dorée, vous ne voyez pas seulement une arme, mais une clé, un billet. Vous savez ce qu'il vous reste à faire. Soyez le messager.
gear-weapon#0145.flat: Among the outcasts of {p}, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.
gear-weapon#0145._raw: Among the outcasts of Efilim, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.

gear-weapon#0146.src: For the hundreds sacrificed for {p}'s survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0146.dst: Pour les centaines de sacrifiés à la survie de {p}, la mort ne fut pas la fin. La magie noire résiduelle et l'énergie corrompue se manifestent dans cette arme en faibles échos du chagrin et de l'agonie des victimes privées de repos.Ça tire vers quelque chose.
gear-weapon#0146.flat: For the hundreds sacrificed for {p}'s survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0146._raw: For the hundreds sacrificed for Troms's survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0147.src: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.
gear-weapon#0147.dst: Affrontez les flammes, la détermination dans le regard. Une fois descendu dans le soufre, vous ne reviendrez pas.
gear-weapon#0147.flat: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.

gear-weapon#0148.src: This profane bow was crafted by a Kander cabal in opposition to the House of Talor's holy relic. Holding it for too long will strain and warp the user's mind.
gear-weapon#0148.dst: Cet arc profane fut fabriqué par une cabale de Kander en opposition à la relique sacrée de la House of Talor. Le tenir trop longtemps met à rude épreuve et déforme l'esprit de son utilisateur.
gear-weapon#0148.flat: This profane bow was crafted by a Kander cabal in opposition to the House of Talor's holy relic. Holding it for too long will strain and warp the user's mind.

gear-weapon#0149.src: One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.
gear-weapon#0149.dst: L'une des nombreuses armes mortelles de Skien. Malgré l'énorme poids de sa tête, Skien maniait ce marteau de guerre si vite qu'on n'en voyait qu'une traînée floue.
gear-weapon#0149.flat: One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.

gear-weapon#0150.src: Reconstructed from mere wooden scraps of its former self, this extremely heavy crossbow still contains immense power. It was intended for use with a lost suit of armor, of which only one piece remains.
gear-weapon#0150.dst: Reconstruite à partir de simples débris de bois de ce qu'elle était, cette arbalète extrêmement lourde renferme encore une puissance immense. Elle était destinée à être utilisée avec une armure perdue, dont il ne reste qu'une seule pièce.
gear-weapon#0150.flat: Reconstructed from mere wooden scraps of its former self, this extremely heavy crossbow still contains immense power. It was intended for use with a lost suit of armor, of which only one piece remains.

gear-weapon#0151.src: The calm before the storm is a time of preparation, of perseverance until clearer days. But this? This is the last moment of peace they will ever know.
gear-weapon#0151.dst: Le calme avant la tempête est un temps de préparation, de persévérance en attendant des jours meilleurs. Mais ceci? C'est le dernier instant de paix qu'ils connaîtront jamais.
gear-weapon#0151.flat: The calm before the storm is a time of preparation, of perseverance until clearer days. But this? This is the last moment of peace they will ever know.

gear-weapon#0152.src: Enigmatically, this weapon will only show itself to those who believe themselves to be worth nothing, or to be weak. While utilizing this weapon will greatly strengthen one's resolve, it will disappear when it is no longer needed, going to the next wielder.
gear-weapon#0152.dst: Mystérieusement, cette arme ne se montre qu'à ceux qui se croient faibles ou sans valeur. Si son usage renforce grandement la détermination, elle disparaît lorsqu'on n'en a plus besoin, pour rejoindre son porteur suivant.
gear-weapon#0152.flat: Enigmatically, this weapon will only show itself to those who believe themselves to be worth nothing, or to be weak. While utilizing this weapon will greatly strengthen one's resolve, it will disappear when it is no longer needed, going to the next wielder.

gear-weapon#0153.src: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.
gear-weapon#0153.dst: Regardez-les recevoir votre cadeau: un désastre imminent et des retombées sans fin.
gear-weapon#0153.flat: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.

gear-weapon#0154.src: To quell the most hateful energies, to focus the most erratic wills, to understand the most alien voices, to shake the most uncaring forces, to capture the most ephemeral potential. The final work of many scholars: to command the world in its most pure being.
gear-weapon#0154.dst: Apaiser les énergies les plus haineuses, concentrer les volontés les plus erratiques, comprendre les voix les plus étrangères, ébranler les forces les plus indifférentes, capturer le potentiel le plus éphémère. L'oeuvre ultime de nombreux érudits: commander au monde dans son être le plus pur.
gear-weapon#0154.flat: To quell the most hateful energies, to focus the most erratic wills, to understand the most alien voices, to shake the most uncaring forces, to capture the most ephemeral potential. The final work of many scholars: to command the world in its most pure being.

gear-weapon#0155.src: "I saw that spider queen once. It felt like it was only a matter of time before she found my home, so I moved here." -Babhla, Nivla Bowl Merchant
gear-weapon#0155.dst: "J'ai vu cette reine araignée une fois. J'avais l'impression que ce n'était qu'une question de temps avant qu'elle trouve ma maison, alors j'ai déménagé ici." -Babhla, marchand de bols de Nivla
gear-weapon#0155.flat: "I saw that spider queen once. It felt like it was only a matter of time before she found my home, so I moved here." -Babhla, Nivla Bowl Merchant

gear-weapon#0156.src: The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.
gear-weapon#0156.dst: Les vents sont une chose curieuse. La brise légère est apaisante, agréable. La bourrasque secoue et brise tout, comme un caprice d'enfant. Seule la tempête détruit vraiment, projetant ses rafales contre quiconque ou quoi que ce soit qui se dresse sur son chemin, ne laissant derrière elle que ruine et poussière.
gear-weapon#0156.flat: The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.

gear-weapon#0157.src: A blade crafted from the ocean's elements. It slices through enemies with the grace of the tides.
gear-weapon#0157.dst: Une lame façonnée à partir des éléments de l'océan. Elle tranche les ennemis avec la grâce des marées.
gear-weapon#0157.flat: A blade crafted from the ocean's elements. It slices through enemies with the grace of the tides.

gear-weapon#0158.src: Only years of training, of building tolerance, has allowed you resistance to the onslaught; channeling the unstoppability of a torrent unleashed. Your enemy stands no chance.
gear-weapon#0158.dst: Seules des années d'entraînement, à forger votre tolérance, vous ont permis de résister à l'assaut, en canalisant la force irrésistible d'un torrent déchaîné. Votre ennemi n'a aucune chance.
gear-weapon#0158.flat: Only years of training, of building tolerance, has allowed you resistance to the onslaught; channeling the unstoppability of a torrent unleashed. Your enemy stands no chance.

gear-weapon#0159.src: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, {p} Priest
gear-weapon#0159.dst: "Les morts entendent encore. Je me dis qu'une berceuse pourrait les convaincre de dormir un peu plus longtemps." -Merloni, prêtre de {p}
gear-weapon#0159.flat: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, {p} Priest
gear-weapon#0159._raw: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, Saint's Row Priest

gear-weapon#0160.src: An attempt to bring power into the hands of one: wealth weaponized across a province to this end. A hero revolted. Crystals burned and plans were brought to dust.
gear-weapon#0160.dst: Une tentative de mettre le pouvoir entre les mains d'un seul: la richesse érigée en arme à travers toute une province dans ce but. Un héros se révolta. Les cristaux brûlèrent et les plans furent réduits en poussière.
gear-weapon#0160.flat: An attempt to bring power into the hands of one: wealth weaponized across a province to this end. A hero revolted. Crystals burned and plans were brought to dust.

gear-weapon#0161.src: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the {p}. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.
gear-weapon#0161.dst: Des gravures et images complexes, presque comme celles d'un totem, couvrent la hampe de ce magnifique trident, remonté des profondeurs de {p}. Des magies étrangères aiguisent les sens de son porteur au combat, mais lui inspirent aussi un désir de l'océan. Beaucoup ont cédé à cet appel et se sont noyés.
gear-weapon#0161.flat: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the {p}. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.
gear-weapon#0161._raw: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the Seavale Reef. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.

gear-weapon#0162.src: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.
gear-weapon#0162.dst: Cet arc, avec lequel les nains portèrent le coup de grâce lors du massacre de Garaheth, est extrêmement puissant. Des gants spéciaux résistants au feu doivent être portés en permanence pour éviter que l'utilisateur ne se brûle.
gear-weapon#0162.flat: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.

gear-weapon#0163.src: Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the {p} hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.
gear-weapon#0163.dst: Forgée avec des écailles enflammées arrachées à Ozoth, cette arme d'hast, légère mais plus dure que l'acier, permettait au légendaire Ninja d'or de {p} de traquer ses proies sans relâche.
gear-weapon#0163.flat: Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the {p} hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.
gear-weapon#0163._raw: Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the Canyon of the Lost hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.

gear-weapon#0164.src: "I am not making this up! That spider teleported ONTO MY FACE!" -Stiba, Elemental Researcher
gear-weapon#0164.dst: "Je n'invente rien! Cette araignée s'est téléportée SUR MON VISAGE!" -Stiba, chercheur élémentaire
gear-weapon#0164.flat: "I am not making this up! That spider teleported ONTO MY FACE!" -Stiba, Elemental Researcher

gear-weapon#0165.src: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.
gear-weapon#0165.dst: L'acte de s'immoler n'est jamais pris à la légère, et c'est toujours un sacrifice. Cette idole fut sculptée en l'honneur de l'un de ces cas, où un maître de la flamme consuma sa force vitale dans un ultime acte d'héroïsme: il purgea une armée de morts-vivants qui gagnait du terrain, sauvant de la destruction les habitants de la jungle.
gear-weapon#0165.flat: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.

gear-weapon#0166.src: Prolonged exposure to the corruption may cause sudden bursts of madness in soldiers. To assure themselves of their sanity, some have even begun to play tricks on their brethren.
gear-weapon#0166.dst: Une exposition prolongée à la corruption peut provoquer de soudains accès de folie chez les soldats. Pour s'assurer qu'ils ont toute leur raison, certains ont même commencé à jouer des tours à leurs frères d'armes.
gear-weapon#0166.flat: Prolonged exposure to the corruption may cause sudden bursts of madness in soldiers. To assure themselves of their sanity, some have even begun to play tricks on their brethren.

gear-weapon#0167.src: She wears a dozen masks, each fragile as the surface of a lake. The shards of her discarded personage are sharp enough to kill.
gear-weapon#0167.dst: Elle porte une douzaine de masques, chacun aussi fragile que la surface d'un lac. Les éclats de ses personnages abandonnés sont assez tranchants pour tuer.
gear-weapon#0167.flat: She wears a dozen masks, each fragile as the surface of a lake. The shards of her discarded personage are sharp enough to kill.

gear-weapon#0168.src: Trapped within the deep reaches of the void holes for millenia, this ancient relic has been unrecognizably warped by its own nonexistence. Instead of integrating back to reality upon its return, it brings with it the manic dissociation from a world that cannot be understood.
gear-weapon#0168.dst: Prisonnière pendant des millénaires des profondeurs des trous du Vide, cette relique antique a été déformée jusqu'à en être méconnaissable par sa propre inexistence. Au lieu de se réintégrer à la réalité à son retour, elle apporte avec elle la dissociation maniaque d'un monde impossible à comprendre.
gear-weapon#0168.flat: Trapped within the deep reaches of the void holes for millenia, this ancient relic has been unrecognizably warped by its own nonexistence. Instead of integrating back to reality upon its return, it brings with it the manic dissociation from a world that cannot be understood.

gear-weapon#0169.src: Holding this staff, you feel less . . . physical. Less real. The wind blows through you, blows past you, as though this world wasn't meant for you at all.
gear-weapon#0169.dst: En tenant ce bâton, vous vous sentez moins... physique. Moins réel. Le vent souffle à travers vous, vous dépasse, comme si ce monde n'était pas du tout fait pour vous.
gear-weapon#0169.flat: Holding this staff, you feel less . . . physical. Less real. The wind blows through you, blows past you, as though this world wasn't meant for you at all.

gear-weapon#0170.src: A curious prototype from the labs of Sock Brewing, simply looking at this liquored effigy begins to induce vertigo, tipsiness, and then shortly afterward the ever-familiar mania which only drink can inspire.
gear-weapon#0170.dst: Curieux prototype sorti des laboratoires de Sock Brewing: rien qu'en regardant cette effigie alcoolisée, on ressent vertige et ivresse, puis bientôt l'euphorie bien connue que seule la boisson peut inspirer.
gear-weapon#0170.flat: A curious prototype from the labs of Sock Brewing, simply looking at this liquored effigy begins to induce vertigo, tipsiness, and then shortly afterward the ever-familiar mania which only drink can inspire.

gear-weapon#0171.src: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of {p}. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.
gear-weapon#0171.dst: Le dieu dogun Garaheth était en réalité un immense démon de feu qui occupait les entrailles de {p}. Si imprudent que ce fût, les nains forgèrent une dague démoniaque avec sa dent pour célébrer sa mise à mort.
gear-weapon#0171.flat: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of {p}. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.
gear-weapon#0171._raw: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of Molten Heights. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.

gear-weapon#0172.src: From coals to conflagration, the flames of War flicker forever.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0172.dst: Des braises à l'embrasement, les flammes de la Guerre vacillent à jamais.Ça tire vers quelque chose.
gear-weapon#0172.flat: From coals to conflagration, the flames of War flicker forever.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0173.src: For when one needs to carve the smallest stone or pick the smallest lock, the subtleties of precision approach impossibility.
gear-weapon#0173.dst: Quand il faut tailler la plus petite pierre ou crocheter la plus petite serrure, les subtilités de la précision frôlent l'impossible.
gear-weapon#0173.flat: For when one needs to carve the smallest stone or pick the smallest lock, the subtleties of precision approach impossibility.

gear-weapon#0174.src: If you reach for ammunition from your quiver, as long as you have a single arrow, you will find you never run out.
gear-weapon#0174.dst: Si vous cherchez des munitions dans votre carquois, tant qu'il vous reste une seule flèche, vous constaterez que vous n'en manquez jamais.
gear-weapon#0174.flat: If you reach for ammunition from your quiver, as long as you have a single arrow, you will find you never run out.

gear-weapon#0175.src: This knife does not belong in your hands... yet somehow it feels right at home.
gear-weapon#0175.dst: Ce couteau n'a rien à faire entre vos mains... et pourtant, il semble y être chez lui.
gear-weapon#0175.flat: This knife does not belong in your hands... yet somehow it feels right at home.

gear-weapon#0176.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this bow has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its string radiates a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0176.dst: Faussement ordinaire, cet arc a été imprégné de l'énergie des cinq éléments connus. Sa corde irradie un spectre de couleurs.
gear-weapon#0176.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this bow has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its string radiates a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0177.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this dagger has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It leaves afterimages that pulsate in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0177.dst: Faussement ordinaire, cette dague a été imprégnée de l'énergie des cinq éléments connus. Elle laisse des images rémanentes qui palpitent dans un spectre de couleurs.
gear-weapon#0177.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this dagger has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It leaves afterimages that pulsate in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0178.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this relik has been infused with energy from all five known elements. The head gleams in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0178.dst: Faussement ordinaire, ce relik a été imprégné de l'énergie des cinq éléments connus. Sa tête luit dans un spectre de couleurs.
gear-weapon#0178.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this relik has been infused with energy from all five known elements. The head gleams in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0179.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this spear has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its tip shimmers in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0179.dst: Faussement ordinaire, cette lance a été imprégnée de l'énergie des cinq éléments connus. Sa pointe chatoie dans un spectre de couleurs.
gear-weapon#0179.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this spear has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its tip shimmers in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0180.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this wand has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It subtly glows in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0180.dst: Faussement ordinaire, cette baguette a été imprégnée de l'énergie des cinq éléments connus. Elle luit subtilement dans un spectre de couleurs.
gear-weapon#0180.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this wand has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It subtly glows in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0181.src: Excessive force is an ideal to strive for. Disproportionate violence is your right to protect.
gear-weapon#0181.dst: La force excessive est un idéal à atteindre. La violence disproportionnée est un droit que vous devez défendre.
gear-weapon#0181.flat: Excessive force is an ideal to strive for. Disproportionate violence is your right to protect.

gear-weapon#0182.src: They have pillaged your faithful houses and razed your sacred fields. Imbued within this lance is an aspect of holy power, and with it you will bring Hell itself up to meet these vile transgressors.
gear-weapon#0182.dst: Ils ont pillé vos maisons de foi et rasé vos champs sacrés. Cette lance est imprégnée d'un aspect du pouvoir sacré, et grâce à elle, vous ferez surgir l'Enfer lui-même à la rencontre de ces vils transgresseurs.
gear-weapon#0182.flat: They have pillaged your faithful houses and razed your sacred fields. Imbued within this lance is an aspect of holy power, and with it you will bring Hell itself up to meet these vile transgressors.

gear-weapon#0183.src: It has witnessed the rise and fall of thousands of civilizations. It has observed the birth and death of millions of stars. It has seen universes open and close. It watches... as each second of eternity passes.
gear-weapon#0183.dst: Elle a vu l'essor et la chute de milliers de civilisations. Elle a observé la naissance et la mort de millions d'étoiles. Elle a vu des univers s'ouvrir et se refermer. Elle observe... tandis que s'écoule chaque seconde de l'éternité.
gear-weapon#0183.flat: It has witnessed the rise and fall of thousands of civilizations. It has observed the birth and death of millions of stars. It has seen universes open and close. It watches... as each second of eternity passes.

gear-weapon#0184.src: These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.
gear-weapon#0184.dst: Ces gantelets d'aspect massif sont en réalité extrêmement légers, car ils sont faits d'un alliage de fer magique béni par les elfes.
gear-weapon#0184.flat: These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.

gear-weapon#0185.src: Many said making a bow out of iron would be slow and wasteful, but the weight of the iron arrow can pierce even stone.
gear-weapon#0185.dst: Beaucoup disaient que fabriquer un arc en fer serait lent et inutile, mais le poids de la flèche de fer peut percer jusqu'à la pierre.
gear-weapon#0185.flat: Many said making a bow out of iron would be slow and wasteful, but the weight of the iron arrow can pierce even stone.

gear-weapon#0186.src: The holy blade of the House of Talor was crafted of pure unicorn horns, and consecrated by a hundred priests. Evil spirits are driven away by its mere presence.
gear-weapon#0186.dst: La lame sacrée de la House of Talor fut façonnée dans des cornes de licorne pures et consacrée par cent prêtres. Sa seule présence chasse les esprits malfaisants.
gear-weapon#0186.flat: The holy blade of the House of Talor was crafted of pure unicorn horns, and consecrated by a hundred priests. Evil spirits are driven away by its mere presence.

gear-weapon#0187.src: "The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage
gear-weapon#0187.dst: "Les lianes que vous trouverez dans le feuillage font d'excellentes cordes!" -Guide d'Alekin sur la corderie en fibres végétales
gear-weapon#0187.flat: "The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage

gear-weapon#0188.src: You do not recognize this place. A labyrinth of foreign walls closes in on you. Paths you have walked a thousand times now alien. Are these your hands? They are made of unfamiliar flesh.
gear-weapon#0188.dst: Vous ne reconnaissez pas cet endroit. Un labyrinthe de murs étrangers se referme sur vous. Des chemins parcourus mille fois vous sont désormais inconnus. Sont-ce bien vos mains? Elles sont faites d'une chair qui vous est étrangère.
gear-weapon#0188.flat: You do not recognize this place. A labyrinth of foreign walls closes in on you. Paths you have walked a thousand times now alien. Are these your hands? They are made of unfamiliar flesh.

gear-weapon#0189.src: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only {~} emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -{p} Self-Defense Class Advertisement
gear-weapon#0189.dst: "Les attaques de bandits vous empêchent de dormir? Cours de combat gratuits ici! Seulement {~} émeraudes, ils ne sauront pas ce qui leur est tombé dessus!" -Publicité pour les cours d'autodéfense de {p}
gear-weapon#0189.flat: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only {~} emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -{p} Self-Defense Class Advertisement
gear-weapon#0189._raw: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only 10 emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -Almuj Self-Defense Class Advertisement

gear-weapon#0190.src: Soldiers and sorcerers, mere men who think themselves judgement. Not so. Judgement is beyond the sword, beyond the staff; justice prefers different weapons. There is nothing, nothing at all, out of its reach.
gear-weapon#0190.dst: Soldats et sorciers, simples hommes qui se prennent pour le jugement. Il n'en est rien. Le jugement est au-delà de l'épée, au-delà du bâton; la justice préfère d'autres armes. Rien, absolument rien, n'est hors de sa portée.
gear-weapon#0190.flat: Soldiers and sorcerers, mere men who think themselves judgement. Not so. Judgement is beyond the sword, beyond the staff; justice prefers different weapons. There is nothing, nothing at all, out of its reach.

gear-weapon#0191.src: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled {p} Resident
gear-weapon#0191.dst: "Quand la vengeance fait loi, le plus sûr est de ne rien faire."  -Ormrod, habitant de {p} en exil volontaire
gear-weapon#0191.flat: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled {p} Resident
gear-weapon#0191._raw: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled Almuj Resident

gear-weapon#0192.src: This bow, which grants its wielder the gift of increased sight, was forged by a blind blacksmith determined to protect others from his sightless fate.
gear-weapon#0192.dst: Cet arc, qui confère à son porteur le don d'une vue accrue, fut forgé par un forgeron aveugle déterminé à épargner aux autres son sort de non-voyant.
gear-weapon#0192.flat: This bow, which grants its wielder the gift of increased sight, was forged by a blind blacksmith determined to protect others from his sightless fate.

gear-weapon#0193.src: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right.  Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?
gear-weapon#0193.dst: Gauche. Droite. Gauche. Droite. Ils cherchent désespérément une issue, simples jouets dans un labyrinthe de votre conception. Gauche. Gauche. Droite.  Demi-tour. Quand des montagnes de pierre se déplacent sur votre ordre, leur monde se réduit à un seul chemin. Gauche. Droite. Cela finira-t-il un jour?
gear-weapon#0193.flat: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right.  Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?

gear-weapon#0194.src: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.
gear-weapon#0194.dst: Quand la cité perdue de Sarnfic sombra dans les profondeurs, seules remontèrent à la surface les bulles des cris et cette unique baguette. Quand on s'en sert, on entend encore la complainte de la ville.
gear-weapon#0194.flat: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.

gear-weapon#0195.src: A rage unseen, yet so beautiful, that when you laid your eyes upon it, you knew it had to be unleashed. No matter the cost.
gear-weapon#0195.dst: Une rage invisible, et pourtant si belle que, lorsque vous avez posé les yeux sur elle, vous avez su qu'il fallait la libérer. Quel qu'en soit le prix.
gear-weapon#0195.flat: A rage unseen, yet so beautiful, that when you laid your eyes upon it, you knew it had to be unleashed. No matter the cost.

gear-weapon#0196.src: Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.
gear-weapon#0196.dst: Beaucoup ont tenté de reproduire les propriétés de cette lance, mais bien peu ont réussi à enchanter une pointe de magie explosive sans que la lance elle-même n'explose.
gear-weapon#0196.flat: Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.

gear-weapon#0197.src:
"Against all heed, to Fruma eternal."
The engraving appears extremely weathered.
gear-weapon#0197.dst:
"Envers et contre tout, pour Fruma éternelle."
La gravure semble extrêmement usée.
gear-weapon#0197.flat: "Against all heed, to Fruma eternal." The engraving appears extremely weathered.

gear-weapon#0198.src: Skien's trust in others was shattered permanently by the wielder of this dagger, who fell to the corruption and attacked his legion during a great corrupted siege.
gear-weapon#0198.dst: La confiance de Skien envers autrui fut brisée à jamais par le porteur de cette dague, qui succomba à la corruption et attaqua sa légion lors d'un grand siège des corrompus.
gear-weapon#0198.flat: Skien's trust in others was shattered permanently by the wielder of this dagger, who fell to the corruption and attacked his legion during a great corrupted siege.

gear-weapon#0199.src: The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!
gear-weapon#0199.dst: Le nom doit forcément être mal écrit... Il n'a même aucun sens!
gear-weapon#0199.flat: The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!

gear-weapon#0200.src: The once-chief of the Iboju tribe held a sacred duty: a revitalizing defense of the jungle, reducing smoldering bones of invaders to rich ash that fed the soil. Yet, as the undead plight wore on, duty curdled into obsession. He became the very monster he sought to destroy, seeing horrors in every living soul and purging them for a land he lost his mind to save.
gear-weapon#0200.dst: L'ancien chef de la tribu Iboju avait un devoir sacré: une défense revitalisante de la jungle, réduisant les os fumants des envahisseurs en une cendre riche qui nourrissait le sol. Mais à mesure que s'éternisait le fléau des morts-vivants, le devoir tourna à l'obsession. Il devint le monstre même qu'il voulait détruire, voyant des horreurs en chaque âme vivante et les purgeant pour une terre qu'il perdit la raison à vouloir sauver.
gear-weapon#0200.flat: The once-chief of the Iboju tribe held a sacred duty: a revitalizing defense of the jungle, reducing smoldering bones of invaders to rich ash that fed the soil. Yet, as the undead plight wore on, duty curdled into obsession. He became the very monster he sought to destroy, seeing horrors in every living soul and purging them for a land he lost his mind to save.

gear-weapon#0201.src: Roll the dice, hit a match. You never miss.
gear-weapon#0201.dst: Lancez les dés, grattez une allumette. Vous ne ratez jamais.
gear-weapon#0201.flat: Roll the dice, hit a match. You never miss.

gear-weapon#0202.src: The real power in madness comes not from some supernatural vigour, but from a sudden lack of interest in self-preservation, and the ensuing ability to do whatever you want.
gear-weapon#0202.dst: Le vrai pouvoir de la folie ne vient pas d'une quelconque vigueur surnaturelle, mais d'une soudaine indifférence envers sa propre survie, et de la capacité qui en découle de faire tout ce que l'on veut.
gear-weapon#0202.flat: The real power in madness comes not from some supernatural vigour, but from a sudden lack of interest in self-preservation, and the ensuing ability to do whatever you want.

gear-weapon#0203.src: The mirror at the core of this artefact reflects back an image of a citadel that does not exist anywhere on this planet.
gear-weapon#0203.dst: Le miroir au coeur de cet artefact renvoie l'image d'une citadelle qui n'existe nulle part sur cette planète.
gear-weapon#0203.flat: The mirror at the core of this artefact reflects back an image of a citadel that does not exist anywhere on this planet.

gear-weapon#0204.src: From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.
gear-weapon#0204.dst: De la porte du Nether fut projeté un éclat de pierre cosmique. Sa pureté fut souillée, et le premier homme à le manier devint fou, délirant sur la chute de la beauté du cosmos.
gear-weapon#0204.flat: From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.

gear-weapon#0205.src: Your soul is stained. Covered in the dirt of deceit and the muck of murder, the sins haunt your every step. Burn it all away, purify your existence in a flash of brilliant light.
gear-weapon#0205.dst: Votre âme est souillée. Couverte de la crasse de la tromperie et de la boue du meurtre, vos péchés hantent chacun de vos pas. Brûlez tout, purifiez votre existence dans un éclair de lumière éclatante.
gear-weapon#0205.flat: Your soul is stained. Covered in the dirt of deceit and the muck of murder, the sins haunt your every step. Burn it all away, purify your existence in a flash of brilliant light.

gear-weapon#0206.src: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of {p}
gear-weapon#0206.dst: "Seuls les plus vils de Gavel pourraient imaginer un fléau tel que celui qui frappe cette province de Wynn." -Roi de {p}
gear-weapon#0206.flat: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of {p}
gear-weapon#0206._raw: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of Ragni

gear-weapon#0207.src: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of {p}, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.
gear-weapon#0207.dst: Perdue par le maître marin Carvel lors d'une violente tempête, elle fut emportée jusqu'à la cité de {p}, où on la trouva crachant écume et éclairs.
gear-weapon#0207.flat: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of {p}, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.
gear-weapon#0207._raw: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of Selchar, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.

gear-weapon#0208.src: You wouldn't even think of committing these atrocities, would you? But what if you weren't the one in control?
gear-weapon#0208.dst: Vous ne songeriez même pas à commettre ces atrocités, n'est-ce pas? Mais si ce n'était pas vous qui teniez les rênes?
gear-weapon#0208.flat: You wouldn't even think of committing these atrocities, would you? But what if you weren't the one in control?

gear-weapon#0209.src: This short spear was the first weapon to be produced by the villagers for sale. They are old, but strong.
gear-weapon#0209.dst: Cette courte lance fut la première arme fabriquée par les villageois pour la vente. Elles sont vieilles, mais solides.
gear-weapon#0209.flat: This short spear was the first weapon to be produced by the villagers for sale. They are old, but strong.

gear-weapon#0210.src: Aloft among the rafters of the crowded theatre a grin crept from ear to ear. Dim the lights. Tick. Raise the curtains. Tick. This shall be their final act. Tick.
gear-weapon#0210.dst: Tout là-haut, parmi les poutres du théâtre bondé, un sourire s'étira jusqu'aux oreilles. Baissez les lumières. Tic. Levez le rideau. Tic. Ce sera leur dernier acte. Tic.
gear-weapon#0210.flat: Aloft among the rafters of the crowded theatre a grin crept from ear to ear. Dim the lights. Tick. Raise the curtains. Tick. This shall be their final act. Tick.

gear-weapon#0211.src: They tense. They know they must hide. The bow will see to it. You will seek. You will find them. The bow will see to it. They will heed your call. They will know your face. The bow will see to it.
gear-weapon#0211.dst: Ils se crispent. Ils savent qu'ils doivent se cacher. L'arc y veillera. Vous chercherez. Vous les trouverez. L'arc y veillera. Ils répondront à votre appel. Ils connaîtront votre visage. L'arc y veillera.
gear-weapon#0211.flat: They tense. They know they must hide. The bow will see to it. You will seek. You will find them. The bow will see to it. They will heed your call. They will know your face. The bow will see to it.

gear-weapon#0212.src: Spiritual enlightenment is a goal that many monks hope to one day grasp the barest glimpse of, often thought to be a goal that must be worked towards over a lifetime. Holding this polished, translucent blade will instantly induce that lofty state until it is let go.
gear-weapon#0212.dst: L'illumination spirituelle est un but dont bien des moines espèrent un jour entrevoir la moindre lueur, et l'on pense souvent qu'il faut y travailler toute une vie. Tenir cette lame polie et translucide induit instantanément cet état sublime, jusqu'à ce qu'on la lâche.
gear-weapon#0212.flat: Spiritual enlightenment is a goal that many monks hope to one day grasp the barest glimpse of, often thought to be a goal that must be worked towards over a lifetime. Holding this polished, translucent blade will instantly induce that lofty state until it is let go.

gear-weapon#0213.src: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.
gear-weapon#0213.dst: Quand on a gravi la plus haute montagne et traversé la plus vaste plaine, que reste-t-il à conquérir? On défie la limite humaine, et l'on tente d'aller au-delà de ce que quiconque a jamais accompli. Sculptée en l'honneur du premier champion, cette idole vous donne le courage de vaincre votre plus grand adversaire: vous-même.
gear-weapon#0213.flat: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.

gear-weapon#0214.src: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel {~} years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.
gear-weapon#0214.dst: Taillée directement dans la mystérieuse roche qui frappa Gavel il y a {~} ans, cette baguette d'un blanc pur luit d'une énergie cosmique inconnue.
gear-weapon#0214.flat: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel {~} years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.
gear-weapon#0214._raw: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel 50 years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.

gear-weapon#0215.src: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.
gear-weapon#0215.dst: L'existence de toute chose se reflète dans les joyaux d'un autre monde de ce grand bâton, assez denses pour posséder leur propre attraction gravitationnelle. Des utilisateurs affirment que leurs membres se sont allongés après usage.
gear-weapon#0215.flat: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.

gear-weapon#0216.src: The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.
gear-weapon#0216.dst: Les elfes parvinrent à dompter la puissance de l'air lui-même, formant un arc entièrement fait de courants d'air, qui permet à son porteur de se déplacer vite comme le vent, mais le rend vulnérable aux attaques.
gear-weapon#0216.flat: The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.

gear-weapon#0217.src: "Controlled burns are healthy, but it's clear why no one wants to do them." -Darek, Alekin Trailblazer
gear-weapon#0217.dst: "Les brûlages dirigés sont sains, mais on comprend pourquoi personne ne veut s'en charger." -Darek, éclaireur d'Alekin
gear-weapon#0217.flat: "Controlled burns are healthy, but it's clear why no one wants to do them." -Darek, Alekin Trailblazer

gear-weapon#0218.src: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, {p} Legion
gear-weapon#0218.dst: "Si vous écrasez un oeuf d'araignée, parfois de petites araignées en sortent. Alors, écrasez plutôt toute la zone!" -Capitaine Fenor, légion de {p}
gear-weapon#0218.flat: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, {p} Legion
gear-weapon#0218._raw: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, Detlas Legion

gear-weapon#0219.src: When the two opposing Realms come to blows, War lashes out with blind enmity. Such is the nature of a Devil, each born from the hate those two Beasts bear.
gear-weapon#0219.dst: Quand les deux Royaumes opposés en viennent aux mains, la Guerre frappe avec une hostilité aveugle. Telle est la nature d'un Diable, chacun né de la haine que se vouent ces deux Bêtes.
gear-weapon#0219.flat: When the two opposing Realms come to blows, War lashes out with blind enmity. Such is the nature of a Devil, each born from the hate those two Beasts bear.

gear-weapon#0220.src: The two mesa tribes once were allies until their sacred totems were stolen. Before that time, however, they often shared their talents, and this bow hewn from mesa stone was one such lost craft.
gear-weapon#0220.dst: Les deux tribus de la mesa furent jadis alliées, jusqu'au vol de leurs totems sacrés. Avant cela, pourtant, elles partageaient souvent leurs talents, et cet arc taillé dans la pierre de la mesa fut l'un de ces savoir-faire perdus.
gear-weapon#0220.flat: The two mesa tribes once were allies until their sacred totems were stolen. Before that time, however, they often shared their talents, and this bow hewn from mesa stone was one such lost craft.

gear-weapon#0221.src: "I have to wonder just how healthy slime found in the depths of a desert  cavern can be to drink." -Eluzterp, {p} resident
gear-weapon#0221.dst: "Je me demande à quel point le slime trouvé au fond d'une caverne du désert peut être bon à boire." -Eluzterp, habitant de {p}
gear-weapon#0221.flat: "I have to wonder just how healthy slime found in the depths of a desert  cavern can be to drink." -Eluzterp, {p} resident
gear-weapon#0221._raw: "I have to wonder just how healthy slime found in the depths of a desert  cavern can be to drink." -Eluzterp, Almuj resident

gear-weapon#0222.src: To hunt in the {p} is always an opportunity. Perhaps hidden between the trees, behind the shrubs, above the canopy, or even within the shadows just behind you, mirroring your every step.
gear-weapon#0222.dst: Chasser dans {p} est toujours une occasion. Peut-être caché entre les arbres, derrière les buissons, au-dessus de la canopée, ou même dans l'ombre juste derrière vous, imitant chacun de vos pas.
gear-weapon#0222.flat: To hunt in the {p} is always an opportunity. Perhaps hidden between the trees, behind the shrubs, above the canopy, or even within the shadows just behind you, mirroring your every step.
gear-weapon#0222._raw: To hunt in the Mistwoods is always an opportunity. Perhaps hidden between the trees, behind the shrubs, above the canopy, or even within the shadows just behind you, mirroring your every step.

gear-weapon#0223.src: This wand merges with the user on touch, bringing about horrific changes to them. Elongated nails, sharp teeth and the ability to breathe fire are trademarks of the beast.
gear-weapon#0223.dst: Cette baguette fusionne avec son utilisateur au toucher, lui infligeant d'horribles transformations. Ongles allongés, dents acérées et capacité de cracher du feu sont les marques de la bête.
gear-weapon#0223.flat: This wand merges with the user on touch, bringing about horrific changes to them. Elongated nails, sharp teeth and the ability to breathe fire are trademarks of the beast.

gear-weapon#0224.src: One of many lost artifacts from the legendary Wind Fortress, the engraving appears to be a cryptic clue to where the Fortress fell. "We shall be found among the dark winds of the morrow."
gear-weapon#0224.dst: L'un des nombreux artefacts perdus de la légendaire Forteresse du Vent; la gravure semble être un indice énigmatique sur l'endroit où la Forteresse est tombée. "On nous trouvera parmi les vents sombres du lendemain."
gear-weapon#0224.flat: One of many lost artifacts from the legendary Wind Fortress, the engraving appears to be a cryptic clue to where the Fortress fell. "We shall be found among the dark winds of the morrow."

gear-weapon#0225.src: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!
gear-weapon#0225.dst: Après tout, le monde tourne autour de vous. Il est grand temps de répandre la nouvelle!
gear-weapon#0225.flat: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!

gear-weapon#0226.src: A year-long monsoon soaked this {p}-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.
gear-weapon#0226.dst: Une mousson d'une année entière a tellement imbibé cet arc fabriqué à {p} qu'il en a capté l'essence même de l'eau.
gear-weapon#0226.flat: A year-long monsoon soaked this {p}-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.
gear-weapon#0226._raw: A year-long monsoon soaked this Nemract-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.

gear-weapon#0227.src: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.
gear-weapon#0227.dst: La puissance combinée des runes Uth gravées et d'une immense sagesse fusionne en une aura impérieuse, car cette arme n'est que le prolongement spirituel du désir de domination absolue de son utilisateur.
gear-weapon#0227.flat: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.

gear-weapon#0228.src: A string so subtle it can slip by the walls of reality, bringing its targets into the space beyond space itself.
gear-weapon#0228.dst: Une corde si subtile qu'elle peut se glisser à travers les murs de la réalité, entraînant ses cibles dans l'espace au-delà de l'espace lui-même.
gear-weapon#0228.flat: A string so subtle it can slip by the walls of reality, bringing its targets into the space beyond space itself.

gear-weapon#0229.src: A bow drawn from the air itself. It imbues the wielder with all the spirit of the wind.
gear-weapon#0229.dst: Un arc tiré de l'air lui-même. Il insuffle à son porteur tout l'esprit du vent.
gear-weapon#0229.flat: A bow drawn from the air itself. It imbues the wielder with all the spirit of the wind.

gear-weapon#0230.src: The diminutive stature of this item belies its abilities. Absorbing and expelling magical energy in precise bursts, it protects the user from all manner of attacks while punishing those who dare strike.
gear-weapon#0230.dst: La petite taille de cet objet masque ses capacités. Absorbant et expulsant l'énergie magique en salves précises, il protège son utilisateur de toutes sortes d'attaques tout en punissant ceux qui osent frapper.
gear-weapon#0230.flat: The diminutive stature of this item belies its abilities. Absorbing and expelling magical energy in precise bursts, it protects the user from all manner of attacks while punishing those who dare strike.

gear-weapon#0231.src: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the {p}, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.
gear-weapon#0231.dst: Ce kriss sacrificiel, tombé du sommet de {p}, est entièrement creux. Le manier, c'est inviter en soi ce même vide. Devenir une telle aberration, s'effacer soi-même en quête de pouvoir... il doit se nourrir de son porteur jusqu'à ce qu'il ne reste que la plus infime existence.
gear-weapon#0231.flat: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the {p}, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.
gear-weapon#0231._raw: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the Tower of Ascension, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.

gear-weapon#0232.src: This ornate knife, which fell from {p} centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.
gear-weapon#0232.dst: Ce couteau orné, tombé de {p} il y a des siècles, est toujours suivi par les ombres du vide, qui masquent le soleil sur une vaste zone alentour. Baigné dans l'obscurité du crépuscule, vous vous sentez enfin réellement libre, car aucune âme ne verra jamais les horreurs que vous commettez.
gear-weapon#0232.flat: This ornate knife, which fell from {p} centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.
gear-weapon#0232._raw: This ornate knife, which fell from Ahmsord centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.

gear-weapon#0233.src: "If anyone finds this, leave it at my Gale's gravesite. I promised her a memento, too." This inscription is extremely weathered.
gear-weapon#0233.dst: "Si quelqu'un trouve ceci, qu'il le laisse sur la tombe de ma Gale. Je lui avais promis un souvenir, à elle aussi." Cette inscription est extrêmement usée.
gear-weapon#0233.flat: "If anyone finds this, leave it at my Gale's gravesite. I promised her a memento, too." This inscription is extremely weathered.

gear-weapon#0234.src: This expertly crafted bow was whittled by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its frame was cut from the very toughest tree roots.
gear-weapon#0234.dst: Cet arc de facture experte fut taillé par un fanatique de la recherche sur les cryptides. Son corps a été découpé dans les racines d'arbre les plus résistantes.
gear-weapon#0234.flat: This expertly crafted bow was whittled by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its frame was cut from the very toughest tree roots.

gear-weapon#0235.src: This expertly crafted dagger was smithed by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It can chop through even the thickest of the swamp's clay with ease.
gear-weapon#0235.dst: Cette dague de facture experte fut forgée par un fanatique de la recherche sur les cryptides. Elle tranche sans peine même l'argile la plus épaisse du marais.
gear-weapon#0235.flat: This expertly crafted dagger was smithed by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It can chop through even the thickest of the swamp's clay with ease.

gear-weapon#0236.src: This expertly crafted relik was notched by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its feathers and baubles chime with a soothing melody.
gear-weapon#0236.dst: Ce relik de facture experte fut entaillé par un fanatique de la recherche sur les cryptides. Ses plumes et breloques tintent d'une mélodie apaisante.
gear-weapon#0236.flat: This expertly crafted relik was notched by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its feathers and baubles chime with a soothing melody.

gear-weapon#0237.src: This expertly crafted spear was forged by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shines brilliantly in even the weakest sunlight.
gear-weapon#0237.dst: Cette lance de facture experte fut forgée par un fanatique de la recherche sur les cryptides. Elle brille de mille feux même sous le plus faible soleil.
gear-weapon#0237.flat: This expertly crafted spear was forged by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shines brilliantly in even the weakest sunlight.

gear-weapon#0238.src: This expertly crafted wand was shaped by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shimmers with the purest water from the swamp.
gear-weapon#0238.dst: Cette baguette de facture experte fut façonnée par un fanatique de la recherche sur les cryptides. Elle chatoie de l'eau la plus pure du marais.
gear-weapon#0238.flat: This expertly crafted wand was shaped by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shimmers with the purest water from the swamp.

gear-weapon#0239.src: Everything dies. Show those who resist the foolishness of their ambitions.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0239.dst: Tout meurt. Montrez à ceux qui résistent la folie de leurs ambitions.Ça tire vers quelque chose.
gear-weapon#0239.flat: Everything dies. Show those who resist the foolishness of their ambitions.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0240.src: True artistry takes time... with the power to sculpt mountains and erode cliffsides into panoramas, the beliefs of your enemies are insignificant. They will understand your greatness... in due time.
gear-weapon#0240.dst: Le véritable art prend du temps... avec le pouvoir de sculpter les montagnes et d'éroder les falaises en panoramas, les convictions de vos ennemis sont insignifiantes. Ils comprendront votre grandeur... en temps voulu.
gear-weapon#0240.flat: True artistry takes time... with the power to sculpt mountains and erode cliffsides into panoramas, the beliefs of your enemies are insignificant. They will understand your greatness... in due time.

gear-weapon#0241.src: Holding this relik sends sparks through your veins, making your heart beat fast. And faster. And faster and faster and--
gear-weapon#0241.dst: Tenir ce relik envoie des étincelles dans vos veines et fait battre votre coeur vite. Plus vite. Plus vite, toujours plus vite et--
gear-weapon#0241.flat: Holding this relik sends sparks through your veins, making your heart beat fast. And faster. And faster and faster and--

gear-weapon#0243.src: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.
gear-weapon#0243.dst: Ils doivent savoir ce que vous avez enduré. Ils doivent souffrir autant que vous.
gear-weapon#0243.flat: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.

gear-weapon#0244.src: Faces have danced around you as long as you can remember, laughing, jeering, mocking. This is your surrender, casting faces of your own into the theatre of your humiliation.
gear-weapon#0244.dst: Des visages dansent autour de vous depuis aussi loin que vous vous souveniez, riant, raillant, se moquant. Voici votre reddition: jeter vos propres visages sur la scène de votre humiliation.
gear-weapon#0244.flat: Faces have danced around you as long as you can remember, laughing, jeering, mocking. This is your surrender, casting faces of your own into the theatre of your humiliation.

gear-weapon#0245.src: "I am only human in the snow. When it melts away, so too do I, for then I am cursed to be a swan."
gear-weapon#0245.dst: "Je ne suis humaine que dans la neige. Quand elle fond, je m'évanouis moi aussi, car je suis alors condamnée à être un cygne."
gear-weapon#0245.flat: "I am only human in the snow. When it melts away, so too do I, for then I am cursed to be a swan."

gear-weapon#0246.src: The song of the world begins as a quiet whistle, calm and peaceful, wrapping 'round the trees and drifting lazily across the fields. It is ever so soft, yet sharper than any sword.
gear-weapon#0246.dst: Le chant du monde commence par un sifflement paisible, calme et serein, qui s'enroule autour des arbres et flotte paresseusement sur les champs. Il est si doux, et pourtant plus tranchant que n'importe quelle épée.
gear-weapon#0246.flat: The song of the world begins as a quiet whistle, calm and peaceful, wrapping 'round the trees and drifting lazily across the fields. It is ever so soft, yet sharper than any sword.

gear-weapon#0247.src: Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.
gear-weapon#0247.dst: Ses crimes furent contre la Décence. Elle riait et crachait, niant la raison et faisant souffrir le monde pour de petites vengeances.
gear-weapon#0247.flat: Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.

gear-weapon#0248.src: The magically rejuvenating properties of phoenix ash were imbued into this grand stave in its creator's bid to gain immortality.
gear-weapon#0248.dst: Les propriétés magiquement régénératrices de la cendre de phénix furent insufflées à ce grand bâton dans la quête d'immortalité de son créateur.
gear-weapon#0248.flat: The magically rejuvenating properties of phoenix ash were imbued into this grand stave in its creator's bid to gain immortality.

gear-weapon#0249.src: Carried by the {p} Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.
gear-weapon#0249.dst: Porté par le Médecin de la peste de {p}, ce bâton d'apparence simple suinte discrètement une substance non identifiée, revigorante pour celui qui le tient et mortellement venimeuse pour tout le reste.
gear-weapon#0249.flat: Carried by the {p} Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.
gear-weapon#0249._raw: Carried by the Olux Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.

gear-weapon#0250.src: With each swing, this ornate hammer threatens to shape mountains and carve valleys, cleaving new fault lines in a single blow.
gear-weapon#0250.dst: A chaque coup, ce marteau orné menace de façonner des montagnes et de creuser des vallées, ouvrant de nouvelles failles d'un seul coup.
gear-weapon#0250.flat: With each swing, this ornate hammer threatens to shape mountains and carve valleys, cleaving new fault lines in a single blow.

gear-weapon#0251.src: Wielding this molten sword, you feel your worries and empathy combust away into corrosive smoke. If one can feel so free, why should it matter if it comes to the detriment of the world around you?
gear-weapon#0251.dst: En maniant cette épée en fusion, vous sentez vos soucis et votre empathie partir en fumée corrosive. Si l'on peut se sentir si libre, qu'importe que ce soit au détriment du monde qui vous entoure?
gear-weapon#0251.flat: Wielding this molten sword, you feel your worries and empathy combust away into corrosive smoke. If one can feel so free, why should it matter if it comes to the detriment of the world around you?

gear-weapon#0253.src: This spear is bright enough that it can cause blindness if you look directly at it. Its immense power is limited by its weight; the weapon is nearly impossible to lift.
gear-weapon#0253.dst: Cette lance est si éclatante qu'elle peut aveugler si on la regarde directement. Son immense pouvoir est limité par son poids; l'arme est presque impossible à soulever.
gear-weapon#0253.flat: This spear is bright enough that it can cause blindness if you look directly at it. Its immense power is limited by its weight; the weapon is nearly impossible to lift.

gear-weapon#0254.src: This staff was expertly crafted from fragile spun glass, and tinted with various magical foci that bend light into its most raw components.
gear-weapon#0254.dst: Ce bâton fut façonné avec maestria dans du verre filé fragile, et teinté de divers foyers magiques qui décomposent la lumière en ses composantes les plus brutes.
gear-weapon#0254.flat: This staff was expertly crafted from fragile spun glass, and tinted with various magical foci that bend light into its most raw components.

gear-weapon#0255.src: The density of this weapon is almost immeasurable. Despite being light and easy to wield, the spear seems to have its own gravitational pull, slowly dragging enemies closer and making it nearly impossible to put down.
gear-weapon#0255.dst: La densité de cette arme est presque incommensurable. Bien que légère et facile à manier, la lance semble posséder sa propre attraction gravitationnelle: elle attire lentement les ennemis et devient presque impossible à lâcher.
gear-weapon#0255.flat: The density of this weapon is almost immeasurable. Despite being light and easy to wield, the spear seems to have its own gravitational pull, slowly dragging enemies closer and making it nearly impossible to put down.

gear-weapon#0256.src: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, {p} Sewer Dweller
gear-weapon#0256.dst: "Laissez-nous crever ici en bas, tiens, pourquoi pas. Faites de nous une statistique de plus et qu'on n'en parle plus, hein?" -Ragamal, habitant des égouts de {p}
gear-weapon#0256.flat: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, {p} Sewer Dweller
gear-weapon#0256._raw: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, Nemract Sewer Dweller

gear-weapon#0257.src: "I always thought Yahya was venom-addled, but the symptoms don't match..." -Pyeka, Alekin Herbalist
gear-weapon#0257.dst: "J'ai toujours cru que Yahya avait l'esprit troublé par le venin, mais les symptômes ne correspondent pas..." -Pyeka, herboriste d'Alekin
gear-weapon#0257.flat: "I always thought Yahya was venom-addled, but the symptoms don't match..." -Pyeka, Alekin Herbalist

gear-weapon#0258.src: The great serpent of Ahms was said to be a bringer of wisdom in days long past, revered by the inhabitants of the region. Totems like this one were crafted as an act of worship, though as belief faded over time, so too were these idols lost and destroyed. Only one remains.
gear-weapon#0258.dst: On disait que le grand serpent d'Ahms apportait la sagesse en des temps reculés, et les habitants de la région le vénéraient. Des totems comme celui-ci étaient sculptés en signe de dévotion, mais à mesure que la foi s'estompait, ces idoles furent elles aussi perdues et détruites. Il n'en reste qu'une.
gear-weapon#0258.flat: The great serpent of Ahms was said to be a bringer of wisdom in days long past, revered by the inhabitants of the region. Totems like this one were crafted as an act of worship, though as belief faded over time, so too were these idols lost and destroyed. Only one remains.

gear-weapon#0259.src: A spear hewn from a radioactive metal. It may be toxic for the wielder, but it is fatal to its enemies.
gear-weapon#0259.dst: Une lance taillée dans un métal radioactif. Elle est peut-être toxique pour son porteur, mais elle est fatale pour ses ennemis.
gear-weapon#0259.flat: A spear hewn from a radioactive metal. It may be toxic for the wielder, but it is fatal to its enemies.

gear-weapon#0260.src: A grave digger uncovered this blade from the resting place of a notorious pirate that pillaged the islands of the ocean for four decades.
gear-weapon#0260.dst: Un fossoyeur exhuma cette lame du lieu de repos d'un pirate notoire qui pilla les îles de l'océan pendant quatre décennies.
gear-weapon#0260.flat: A grave digger uncovered this blade from the resting place of a notorious pirate that pillaged the islands of the ocean for four decades.

gear-weapon#0261.src: To call an end a new beginning implies there ever was a beginning, or ever will be an end.
gear-weapon#0261.dst: Appeler une fin un nouveau commencement suppose qu'il y ait jamais eu un commencement, ou qu'il y aura jamais une fin.
gear-weapon#0261.flat: To call an end a new beginning implies there ever was a beginning, or ever will be an end.

gear-weapon#0262.src: The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.
gear-weapon#0262.dst: La flamme vacillante au sommet de cette simple baguette est une merveille de magie. Elle brûle toujours à une chaleur agréable, ne brûle pas la peau même au toucher, et ne peut jamais être éteinte, quelles que soient les circonstances.
gear-weapon#0262.flat: The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.

gear-weapon#0263.src: Finally, the pulse of melody and harmony flies through golden halls, flung by the momentum of life itself. A single knock of polished wood on chiselled stone, and the song of the world falls silent.
gear-weapon#0263.dst: Enfin, la pulsation de la mélodie et de l'harmonie s'envole à travers les salles dorées, portée par l'élan de la vie même. Un seul coup de bois poli sur la pierre ciselée, et le chant du monde se tait.
gear-weapon#0263.flat: Finally, the pulse of melody and harmony flies through golden halls, flung by the momentum of life itself. A single knock of polished wood on chiselled stone, and the song of the world falls silent.

gear-weapon#0264.src: Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.
gear-weapon#0264.dst: Bien qu'on ait prouvé qu'il n'avait aucun lien avec elles, cet arc énigmatique fut l'élément déclencheur de la grande quête des Reliques.
gear-weapon#0264.flat: Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.

gear-weapon#0265.src: Despite this mace never seeing use by Remikas, it was seen as a symbol of the might of his rule over Gavel. Its true abilities in battle have never been seen.
gear-weapon#0265.dst: Bien que Remikas ne s'en soit jamais servi, cette masse était considérée comme le symbole de la puissance de son règne sur Gavel. Ses véritables capacités au combat n'ont jamais été vues.
gear-weapon#0265.flat: Despite this mace never seeing use by Remikas, it was seen as a symbol of the might of his rule over Gavel. Its true abilities in battle have never been seen.

gear-weapon#0266.src: "Skin worked so thin, we see the bone; she grinds us up from on her throne. Their houses made of flimsy steel; scars from bombs will never heal."
gear-weapon#0266.dst: "Peau si usée qu'on voit les os; elle nous broie, de son trône, sans repos. Leurs maisons d'acier si frêle; les cicatrices des bombes sont éternelles."
gear-weapon#0266.flat: "Skin worked so thin, we see the bone; she grinds us up from on her throne. Their houses made of flimsy steel; scars from bombs will never heal."

gear-weapon#0267.src: Her crimes were against the State. She burned and pillaged, making a mockery of law and civility throughout the land.
gear-weapon#0267.dst: Ses crimes furent contre l'État. Elle brûlait et pillait, bafouant la loi et la civilité à travers tout le pays.
gear-weapon#0267.flat: Her crimes were against the State. She burned and pillaged, making a mockery of law and civility throughout the land.

gear-weapon#0268.src: The power to join oneself with the lifeblood of the earth has long eluded sects of fanatical druids and shamans. One such cult found a way, and subsequently wiped itself out in the process, their flesh turning to stone and veins forming new rivers.
gear-weapon#0268.dst: Le pouvoir de s'unir au sang vital de la terre échappe depuis longtemps aux sectes de druides et de chamans fanatiques. L'un de ces cultes trouva un moyen, et s'anéantit dans le processus: la chair de ses membres se changea en pierre et leurs veines formèrent de nouvelles rivières.
gear-weapon#0268.flat: The power to join oneself with the lifeblood of the earth has long eluded sects of fanatical druids and shamans. One such cult found a way, and subsequently wiped itself out in the process, their flesh turning to stone and veins forming new rivers.
